review.tagline: Native Windows and macOS desktop client for DeepSeek Harness
review.summary: DSH Desktop wraps the pinned, unmodified upstream DeepSeek Harness web UI, host service and plugin system in a native desktop app with window, tray, terminal and auto-update. The desktop shell is itself a DSH plugin, and the app includes a plugin market and phone remote control (iOS/Android, from 2.0.9). Installers cover Windows x64 and macOS Universal; no Node.js is needed.
review.audience: Windows and macOS users who want a packaged DeepSeek Harness app with plugins
strengths: Installers for Windows x64 and macOS Universal, no separate Node.js install
Runs a pinned, unmodified upstream DeepSeek Harness version
Built-in plugin market and desktop services for third-party plugins
Web service listens on loopback only by default
weaknesses: LAN access option has no authentication, per the README
Tied to DeepSeek Harness; independent project, not affiliated with DeepSeek
README and docs are primarily in Chinese
